description.en: Gemini API key account type. The gemini platform and its endpoints (/v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent, :streamGenerateContent, :countTokens) are built into the core; model prices are set by administrators in the core.
description.zh: Gemini API Key 账号类型（gemini 平台及其端点 /v1beta/models/{model}:generateContent、:streamGenerateContent、:countTokens 由核心内置；模型价格由管理员在核心中配置）。

description.en: A Google AI Studio (Gemini API) key, or a key for a Gemini-compatible endpoint (set Base URL).
description.zh: Google AI Studio（Gemini API）的 Key，或 Gemini 兼容端点的 Key（需填写 Base URL）。

reason.en: Register the Gemini API key account type for the built-in gemini platform
reason.zh: 为内置 gemini 平台注册 Gemini API Key 账号类型

reason.en: Read the API key of accounts of its own account type (Gemini API Key) to call the upstream API
reason.zh: 读取本插件账号类型（Gemini API Key）账号的 API Key 以调用上游接口
